description: Dreamwalker Spaulders Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Spaulders if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 1 Nexus Crystal. Requirements: - Desecrated Spaulders - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 12 - Cured Rugged Hide x 5 - Nexus Crystal
name: Dreamwalker Spaulders
